They have cat ears â€” soft grey, mobile, a mod that predates their PI license and that they have kept because they pick up certain vocal frequencies the human ear misses, which turns out to be professionally useful in a way they did not originally intend.

Hakim Bergqvist runs a small private investigation practice that caters to Tier 2 and low Tier 3 clients â€” people who cannot afford legal representation and cannot access Arcturus Civil Security interest because their problems are too small or too inconvenient.
